paragraphs.text: Evelyn Cisneros was a very shy kid. But she grew up to become a star dancer.
Evelyn's family was from Mexico, and she was born in California. Her mother worried that Evelyn was too shy. So she put Evelyn in dance classes when Evelyn was just a young child.

At first, Evelyn was scared to dance in front of other people. She did not want to go to dance class. But her mother told her to try dancing for a year. Evelyn practiced and practiced. She soon learned that she loved to dance!

paragraphs.text: Eric Carle's books for children delight readers around the world. Eric wrote more than seventy colorful books during his lifetime. But he did more than just write the books. He made the art for them, too.

pieces.text: Eric made almost all of his pictures using a kind of art called

content.text: collage

paragraphs.text: Many years ago, Bessie Smith became a famous singer. A lot of Americans enjoyed listening to her sing. But some of her fans might be surprised to learn that Bessie grew up very poor.

When she was young, she started singing on the street. This was a way to earn money for her family. After a few years, she was hired to sing with a group that traveled around the South. Crowds came to shows just to hear her sing. Soon, she had her own show. Many famous musicians came from far away for the chance to play music with Bessie.
Bessie sang music called the blues. People liked the stories Bessie's songs told. The songs were about everyday people. Her singing could make listeners cry. But it could make them laugh, too.
Many other famous singers have learned from Bessie's music. Today, Bessie is known as one of the greatest blues singers of all time.

paragraphs.text: Stephen Hawking was a curious kid. He and his family liked to learn new things. In fact, they would often read books while eating dinner. Stephen was especially interested in learning about space. So when he grew up, he became a scientist. He came up with new ideas about how things work in space.

When Stephen was twenty-one, he became sick with an unusual disease. This illness changed his body. Soon, he could not move his arms and legs. So, he spent the rest of his life in a wheelchair. Later, he lost his voice and learned to speak through a computer. But these things did not stop Stephen from being a great scientist.
Stephen kept sharing his ideas. He wrote books about space. He wrote in a simple way so everyone could understand his ideas. People all over the world read Stephen's books.

paragraphs.text: Barnum Brown found his first fossils when he was about five years old. A fossil is something from a plant or animal that lived a long time ago. His first fossils were very old seashells.
Barnum found many fossils. He kept them in a shed outside. And when his family had visitors, Barnum would show them what he had found. It was his first museum!

When Barnum grew up, he got a job hunting for fossils for a famous museum. One day, he made an amazing discovery. He found a piece of a new dinosaur skeleton. This dinosaur was a Tyrannosaurus rex, or T. rex. Six years later, Barnum found an even more complete skeleton of a T. rex. This skeleton included an entire skull.
Barnum was one of the most famous fossil hunters of all time. He searched for fossils all over the world. He made so many discoveries that some people call him the Father of the Dinosaurs!

paragraphs.text: Susan B. Anthony's parents taught her that everyone should be equal. They said all people should be allowed to do the same things.
When Susan was alive, life was different in the United States. Men and women were not treated equally. Laws said that women could not vote. It was also hard for women to earn money or own houses.

But Susan believed that women were equal to men. She was a good speaker, and she shared her ideas with crowds all over the United States. She said that laws about women should change. She told the crowds that women should get paid as much as men for the same work. She also said women should be allowed to vote.
Susan became famous for her ideas. She worked with other people to help get some laws changed. Today, thanks to their hard work, women can vote, earn more money, and own houses.
